messages:
jamie: Noticed a regression after the micro-scan kernel heuristics landed. p95 host overhead for tiny chats up ~24ms. GPU profiles unchanged.

jamie: Quick sample from traces:
```
host_total_ms p50: 1.8  p95: 62 (+24)
parse_tokenize_ms p95: 17.6 (+15)
streaming_fanout_ms p95: 6.0 (many small writev calls)
kvcache_lookup_ms p95: 0.8
```

noor: micro-scan? Which CL did we push? I think we added an inline prefingerprint that scans token boundaries to choose quant/kernels early.

ryan: That inline scan runs synchronously in ingress. If it triggers our legacy token pipeline it will load ICU and do memcpy-heavy normalization. Any flamegraph?

jamie: Flamegraph shows large stacks at ingress.read -> inline_scan -> proto_unwrap -> utf8_norm -> token_adapter_legacy. Also a separate hotspot with syscall nodes from split writev -> multiple small frames.

noor: The fingerprint mapping still has an old suffix rule for certain http2 metadata shapes. The scanner inspects first 48 bytes and ends up hitting the legacy branch more often for tiny payloads.

ops-bot: Canary rollback executed: reverted CL 9f1a33 on canary at 14:05 UTC.

jamie: After rollback p95 returned to near baseline in ~7m. KV stats unchanged. This is clearly host-side parsing + streaming framing.

ryan: Repro steps: grpc streaming with short prompt + client metadata -> observe extra open("/usr/lib/icu/...") on slow path and strace shows 3-4 writev calls instead of 1.

noor: Plan of attack:
- remove inline synchronous micro-scan from ingress hot path, move it to async fingerprinting off critical path
- extend fingerprint table to include common http2/grpc metadata shapes so scanner selects token_adapter_v2 for short chats
- change chunker to prefer coalesced writev; only split if payload > 1KB or when we have many queued frames
- add a targeted e2e that sends 1-10 token prompts over streaming and asserts p95 below threshold

ryan: Also propose an ascii-bailout: fast byte scan that avoids ICU when bytes are all <= 0x7F. Cheap and high payoff for short english prompts.

jamie: I'll open a PR with the async move + tests. Noor can update the fingerprint table. Ryan can iterate on chunker coalescing. Marking P0 for Dedicated clusters until fixes land.

ops-bot: Statless canary scheduled with micro-scan disabled, chunker coalesce enabled at 15:10 UTC. Collecting perf traces for 20m.

noor: Thanks, will paste trace diffs here when ready. :thumbsup:
